title: Trip Splash
desc: A wordmark collapses into a dot that streaks across the screen and reveals the home screen.
long: A launch animation driven by a single clock. The wordmark spreads out from the orange dot, collapses into it, and the dot stretches into a gradient line that sweeps off the right edge. The moment the line head touches the edge, a fast circular sweep reveals the home screen. Tap to replay.
spec: One TimelineView drives every piece from a shared time value t.
0.45 to 0.80 s: letters spread, the dot swells, then everything collapses into the dot.
From 0.80 s the dot stretches into a gradient line that exits right on a closed-form curve.
When the line head reaches the right edge, a circular mask grows from the left over 0.45 s.
